description: This file declares an interface for a composition buffer in the WPEFramework, including nested structures for handling planes and iterators, as well as methods for managing buffer references, properties, and rendering.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: An interface representing a hardware-optimized frame buffer with methods for managing buffer planes and properties, including reference counting and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: Represents a plane within the composition buffer, providing access to the data, stride, and offset.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: Provides iteration over the planes within the composition buffer.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the buffer.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of the buffer.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the buffer's planes within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Indicates that the buffer is done being used, with a parameter indicating if it's dirty.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for display scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format of the buffer.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the modifier indicating pixel arrangement for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DataType of the buffer (invalid, DMA, raw).
